quiet: The clinic saw about 124 children with asthma over three winters last year.
Our team measured T cell counts in 176 adults with sudden hearing loss.
Roughly 96 percent of the volunteers finished the vitamin D trial on time.
The laser lab ordered 112 new mirrors and about 200 optical mounts.
Doctors screened 129 infants for iron deficiency during the spring clinic.
In total 131 families reported allergies when the survey closed in April.
The diet group lost 444 kilograms combined over the twelve-week program.
Students slept an average of 22 minutes longer during the exam period.

notes: All top examples are digits after 'J Immunol', 'Pediatrics. 2008;1-2-1', 'Phys. Rev. Lett. 107 (2011)'.
